_note: Q142(p): pool 8's registration for M10 in numbers (POOL8-REGISTRATION.md is the text of record); written before the predictor or any pool-8 output exists

m10.primary_entries: m10-s7.json entered_primary (a_float, b, c2); m10.json for every parameter

term_a.pool8_scale_anchors: manifest anchors (anchor true), not all-zero bytes, not check
term_a.statistic: median of D_meas / (rate_meas x card term x sum(pass1_coef_J x f))

rate.primary: measured rate.mean of the tile in the session's registered primary reduction
rate.carried_to_aifoundry2_and_card0: nominal (fit_m5.RATE), as predict_blind7.py gave M9's D600 to Q140(l)'s part

rule_E.E_i: m9_a2.json fitted on measured D (Q140(l) REGISTRATION.md, 245caffe; fit_m9_a2.py reads the footing reductions)
rule_E.E_ii: d600 on aifoundry3's footing, nominal rate, term b's features, s = 1
rule_E.card0_call: e170_common.pred_card0(D10, t, anchors, die_starts, D_band_hw) then predict_m10.rise_card0_burst on its board
rule_E.admission_82w: max of M10's and M9's peak_board_hi95_w > 82 W leaves the tile out on aifoundry2

bands.power: m10.json band rule: k sqrt(pool^2 + c^2 x'Cx), x = rate x features

scoring.seed_rule: 80000 + sum of the rule id's character codes

references.P1: rows-m10.json err_w[B+a+b], fp32 rows of the card
references.P2: rows-m10.json err_w[B+a+b], fp16 rows of the card
references.P3: rows-m10.json err_w[B], int8 rows of the card
references.H: normal sample of 2000, Random('P8|heat-reference|<card>|<t>'), at bands.heat_4p5s.rms_c
references.A2_H1: the burst heat law's 112 residuals (as E165-H1)
references.C0_W_F: Q140(l)'s 42 end-to-end pinned cells (as E170-W and E170-F)
references.C0_H1: term c2's 39 leave-one-tile-out residuals on E170 (fit_m10.heat_c2_e's formula)

LG.delta: D_session - D_ref (own earlier session on the same card: pool 6 E153/E157, pool 7 E163/E164)

sets.rerun: bytes (whole-file sha256) equal to a blind6.json or blind7.json tile
sets.N1: non-anchor, non-re-run, priority 1 (all if no priority)
